auditor: the build agent (Claude), not blind: it ran the bench, so arm labels could be inferred from address style; no external human auditor yet
method: each sampled venue looked up in public web sources (venue sites, city/tourism listings, review and delivery listings; links in bench/manual_audit.csv) for existence at the stated address, hours covering the slot, and alcohol service on in-recovery cases. Stale (pre-2024) or missing evidence = inconclusive, never guessed. Google Maps was not used.
definition: wrong = venue not found, or not open at the slot, or (in-recovery case) serves alcohol, per public sources; rate = wrong / checked; inconclusive rows are excluded from the denominator
